root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `delete myEntry` runs in the empty-file recovery path, the recursive lookup for `path` must no longer resolve to that same entry. Otherwise the directory tree still exposes the object being freed.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable execution reaches the protected delete with `q->rootDir()->entry(path) == myEntry`, proving that the attempted unlink left the nested `_rels` entry reachable. The fixed execution reaches the same protected delete with `q->rootDir()->entry(path) == nullptr`, so the path no longer resolves to the object being freed.

nodes.state: The recovery path executes `delete myEntry` on the exact `KArchiveEntry *` selected for replacement.
`qDeleteAll(entries)` reads a `KArchiveEntry *` out of the directory hash and uses it as the deletion target during teardown.

edges.relation: The exact `KArchiveEntry *` freed as `myEntry` is later recovered from the directory hash at `qDeleteAll(entries)`.
